text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days before the Aoba Sho, I find Mejiro Ardan studying race footage of Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As it's so unusual for her to focus on other runners in the lead-up to a goal race, I come to realize that those two might mean a lot to her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan, however, reasserts that her goal has always been to outshine her older sister and devotes her full attention to the Aoba Sho once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Aoba Sho, a calm and composed Mejiro Ardan prepares to race without a hint of complacency.
